revenue_growth.source: Assumption: revenue fell 9.5% in FY2024 and 6.2% in FY2025 (filed revenue); modest further decline then recovery to roughly inflation-lagging growth, with flat commodity prices assumed.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: EBIT not available from the filing data. Anchored loosely on FY2025 net income attributable of 13.127B / revenue 201.196B = 6.5% (filed); 10% allows for tax, minorities and financing costs. Reviewer should replace with filed EBIT margin.

tax_rate.source: Damodaran Europe Oil/Gas (Integrated) effective tax rate 40.3% (dataset 2026-01-05); reflects high-tax upstream mix.

da_pct_revenue.source: Placeholder assumption, NOT from filings (D&A not found in data). Asset-heavy integrated oil; reviewer must replace with filed D&A / revenue.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Placeholder assumption, NOT from filings (capex not found in data). Set slightly above D&A for modest growth investment; reviewer must replace with filed capex / revenue.

wacc.source: Assumption. Mechanical CAPM: Rf 3.266% (ECB 10Y AAA, 2026-11-05) + relevered beta ~0.465 (Damodaran Europe integrated oil unlevered cash-corrected 0.406, D/E 0.194, tax 25%) x France ERP 5.006% = Ke ~5.6%; Kd 5.18% pre-tax; yields WACC ~5.3%. Rounded up to 7% for commodity-price and energy-transition risk; low raw beta understates risk.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 3.27% EUR risk-free rate and long-run inflation, reflecting mature, transition-exposed hydrocarbon business.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt: borrowings noncurrent 48.995 + current 12.038 - cash 26.202 = 34.831 USD bn (ESEF 529900S21EQ1BO4ESM68-2025-12-31-ESEF-FR-0); no short-term investments reported

diluted_shares.source: Not directly reported in the data (diluted_shares null). Derived: net income attributable 13.127B / diluted EPS 5.78 = ~2.271 billion shares; approximate, hybrid coupons may affect it. Reviewer to verify against the filing.
